about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Computer Science student at Bilkent University with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications. I enjoy designing backend systems that are reliable, performant, and easy to maintain.
about.paragraph2: Currently working as a Software Engineer at Look & Cash, building full-stack & devops solutions using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, MongoDB and AWS.

educationItems.detail: GPA: 97.3/100 — Established the school's MUN branch

bullets: Ticket-Based Support System: Built a ticket workflow for web/mobile with priority, comments, attachments, and statuses. Shipped 13 REST endpoints, 4 ticket states, and 5 admin actions; reduced average admin handling time by 25%.

Real-Time Mobile Support Chat: Implemented real-time ticket chat on mobile with backend persistence and state sync. Achieved 300 ms p95 message delivery and 99.5% delivery success under 150 concurrent sessions.

Reporting & Graph Generation: Built KPI reporting APIs over MongoDB with date-range and campaign filters. Generated 14 dashboard datasets powering 4 chart types; cut report generation time from 6.2s to 1.9s.
Admin Landing Page Dashboard: Built an admin dashboard showing 12 KPIs with a sidebar linking to 9 admin pages; reduced navigation from 5 clicks to 2 clicks for common tasks.

items.name: Artifactum
items.label: CS319 — Software Engineering Project
items.description: Owned artifact ingestion and LLM features for a MERN application. Integrated Gemini for artifact generation/analysis with 6 prompt workflows and 1% LLM-call failure rate. Built S3 multi-file and ZIP bulk uploads processing up to 50 MB / 200 files. Designed MongoDB collections with 8 indexes, improving p95 query latency from 420 ms to 90 ms.

items.name: Immune Wars
items.label: CS102 — Intro to Programming II (Feb – May 2024)
items.description: Educational game about the immune system built as a semester project. Features a graph-based body model where players defend against pathogens using immune cells. Designed game mechanics, pathogen AI, and visual feedback systems.

items.name: NutriApp
items.label: Amazon University Engagement Program
items.description: Built backend services for a meal-planning app. Implemented 16 serverless REST API endpoints on AWS Lambda with p95 latency of 450 ms. Won the People's Choice Award — top 1 of 7 teams.
Leading the advisory board and guiding strategic direction of the Formula Student team.
Organized 20+ events and contributed to team operations and outreach.
Led editorial team and managed publication of the university magazine.
Organized career summit and Mercedes Career Talks events.

items.organization: Bilkent Data Science and Analytics Society
items.description: Organized a 6-part Data Science workshop series for the university community.
